title: Certify a single P104 matching with complete relaxed support
body:
## Summary

```text
Same 208 departure/arrival slots and fixed covers
PR3013 matching:    45 missing required dependencies, all at Y40
Four-edge cycle:   139 → 154 → 182 → 179 → 139
New single match:  0 missing, all 4,992 required dependencies reachable
```

Closes PR3013's matching-coherent handoff without pooling incompatible matchings. The cycle changes only four assignments. A new dimension-four contact joins Y40's former isolated component without changing Y40's incoming matching edges.

Package: `research/p104-coherent-support-witness`. Exact witness, original control, full support masks, proof boundary and open next question are included. Started from canonical main `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`, priority revision 6; final main and PR3013 head are unchanged.

This passes a necessary dependency test, **not** a correction program or new κ. Intermediate contacts may be mutually inconsistent. Full flags, chronology, coefficients, arbitrary dirty restoration and complete physical/consumer costs remain unresolved. Reported stronger program-level lifetime floors are not contradicted. No selected-frontier change or construction expansion.

## Evidence

- **Before:** reproduce PR2981's 3,095-missing and PR3013's 45-missing controls.
  **After:** the explicit matching has every required path and all 104 sources at every target.
- Exact interval/component propagation agrees with literal quotient-subspace enumeration and a separate per-source directed BFS. Parsing, prescribed-frame reconstruction and Gram arithmetic are shared, not independently audited twice.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay and optimized 3.13.5 checks pass locally, including nine behavioral groups, meaningful rejecting controls and a read-only Git-free export. Ruff, warnings-as-errors compilation and committed-byte preflight pass. All 10 package files and three external inputs match commit `44d12bdeb8ade4066645bd968bebd4756b06200a`.
- Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-coherent-support-witness`.

No full supplier/native/outer replay, independent human/formal review or hosted-CI conclusion is claimed. Final overlap refresh covered 261 open PRs and 1,736 Discussion records, completely paginated, plus local historical metadata. It excludes arbitrary diffs and unpublished work.

Credit Nick Petalas/PR3013/2996/2981/2920, Arham Tahir/PR2997, and the retained channel, information-flow and geometry/native lineage detailed in the README. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2245#discussioncomment-18979257).

## Merge danger

**Door:** Two-way. One additive opt-in research package.

**Blast radius:** Package. Frozen predecessors, shared checkers, priorities and the selected frontier are unchanged.
